stories.h: Bank marketer allegedly caught cheating with customer, her explanation leaves husband speechless
stories.p: A married woman said to work as a bank marketer is at the centre of an online controversy after her husband allegedly caught her with one of the bank's customers. The explanation she reportedly gave when confronted has got people talking, although none of the details have been independently verified.
body: A married woman who reportedly works as a bank marketer has found herself at the centre of a heated online controversy after her husband allegedly caught her having an affair with one of the bank's customers.
## When customer relations go too far
Everyone knows bank marketers are expected to keep good relationships with their customers. Attracting clients and keeping them happy is part of the job.
But in this case, the woman allegedly took customer relations far beyond anything her husband ever imagined.
## The explanation
What has made the story even more talked about is the explanation she reportedly gave after being confronted, which is said to have left her husband speechless.

The exact details of her response, and of the incident itself, have not been independently verified, and the people involved have not been identified. Even so, the story has sparked fresh conversation about trust, marriage and the boundaries of professional relationships.
## Over to you
Seriously, how do you explain something like this to your husband?
Was she simply doing her job, or did customer service become something else entirely?
more: The woman reportedly works as a bank marketer.
Her explanation has not been independently verified.
The story has sparked debate about professional boundaries.

stories.h: Pastor Jimmy Odukoya introduces new wife as Fountain of Life Church welcomes another 'Mummy G.O.'
stories.p: Pastor Jimmy Odukoya, Senior Pastor of The Fountain of Life Church, has reportedly introduced his new wife to the congregation. The news has revived an old debate about how Nigerian churches treat divorce among their leaders compared with ordinary members.
body: Pastor Jimmy Odukoya, the Senior Pastor of The Fountain of Life Church, has reportedly introduced his new wife to the congregation, bringing fresh attention to his personal life and to the church's leadership.
Photos from the occasion show the couple dressed in matching red outfits, smiling together on the church stage.
## Background
For those who may not know, Pastor Jimmy was previously married to Kemi Odukoya, and the marriage produced two children. That marriage reportedly ended some years ago.

His sister, who also serves as an associate pastor in the church, has spoken publicly about the breakdown of her own marriage, including her personal experiences and how her faith in God carried her through that difficult period.
The Fountain of Life Church was founded by their late parents, Pastors Taiwo and Bimbo Odukoya, and the children have continued the family's ministry.
## A question about double standards
The news raises a question about how marriage and divorce are discussed in some Nigerian churches.

Many religious institutions regularly remind ordinary members that marriage is sacred and that the Bible says God hates divorce. Some believers are even made to feel guilty for leaving marriages that have become unbearable.

Yet when divorce happens within prominent pastoral families, the conversation often becomes more understanding. Suddenly, people are encouraged to consider personal circumstances, healing, forgiveness and new beginnings.
Perhaps they should. Pastors are human beings too. But shouldn't ordinary church members receive that same understanding?
## Finding love again

There is nothing wrong with anyone finding love again after a failed marriage. The concern is the apparent gap between what some churches preach to their members and how they respond when their own leaders face similar situations.
So the question is this: if divorce can be understood and accepted when it involves church leaders, why should ordinary Christians sometimes be made to feel condemned for the same decision?
What is your opinion?
more: Pastor Jimmy Odukoya was previously married to Kemi Odukoya.
The church was founded by his late parents, Taiwo and Bimbo Odukoya.
The news has reopened debate about how churches handle divorce.

stories.h: Sanwo-Olu becomes 'part-time model' on Lagos Fashion Week runway
stories.p: Lagos Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu walked the runway at Lagos Fashion Week on Saturday in an outfit from designer Ugo Monye's collection, drawing cheers from the crowd. He shared the video online, calling himself a model for one night.
body: Lagos State Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu surprised fashion lovers by taking to the runway at Lagos Fashion Week on Saturday night, 31 October 2026.
## What happened

The governor modelled a native outfit from the collection of designer Ugo Monye, walking the catwalk to loud cheers from the audience. At the end of the show, he returned to the runway with the designer, and the two shook hands and walked out together to applause.
## What he said

Sanwo-Olu shared footage of the moment on his social media pages, describing it as a welcome break from his usual work and calling himself a part-time model for the night. He said he had a really good time and congratulated the designer and everyone working to make Lagos a hub of creativity, fashion and talent.
## How people reacted

The video drew warm and humorous reactions. Actress Funke Akindele described it as dope, while broadcaster Do2dtun praised the governor for supporting the entertainment industry. Other users joked that the governor had found a side hustle.
## Background

Lagos Fashion Week is one of Africa's biggest fashion events and showcases designers from Nigeria and across the continent. Sanwo-Olu, who is serving his second and final term, often appears at cultural and entertainment events in the state and has promoted Lagos as a centre for the creative economy. Earlier this week, a video of him giving flowers to his wife also went viral.
more: Sanwo-Olu modelled an outfit by designer Ugo Monye.
He called himself a 'part-time model' for the night.
Funke Akindele and Do2dtun praised the moment.

stories.h: Federal government's CREDICORP unveils SPARK loans for people without smartphones
stories.p: The Nigerian Consumer Credit Corporation has unveiled SPARK, a credit product that lets people borrow through USSD on basic mobile phones, without internet access. It is aimed at first-time and low-income borrowers and is expected to be widely available before the end of 2026.
body: Nigerians without smartphones or internet access may soon be able to borrow money through a new government-backed scheme.
## What was unveiled

The Nigerian Consumer Credit Corporation (CREDICORP) launched SPARK at a 'CREDICORP for All' event in Aba, Abia State, attended by more than 1,000 residents, according to reports on Sunday, 1 November 2026. The product works on USSD, the basic mobile service available on simple feature phones, allowing eligible users to start credit transactions without a data connection.
## Who it is for

SPARK is aimed at first-time borrowers, low-income earners and others who are poorly served by traditional banks. CREDICORP says it will also help users build formal credit histories by borrowing and repaying responsibly. Loan sizes, interest rates and eligibility rules were not disclosed, and the USSD code has not yet been published. CREDICORP expects the product to be widely available before the end of 2026.
## Who spoke
CREDICORP's chief executive, Uzoma Nwagba, spoke at the event, along with a representative of Abia Governor Alex Otti and an official of the Ministry of Finance Incorporated.
## Background

CREDICORP was set up in 2024 to expand access to consumer credit, so that Nigerians can buy goods such as phones, solar systems and household items and pay over time. Many Nigerians rely on online loan apps, some of which have been criticised for high interest rates and harsh debt-recovery methods.
## A warning
Officials urged people to wait for official announcements and to avoid unverified platforms claiming to register people for SPARK loans.
more: SPARK works through USSD on basic phones.
It targets first-time and low-income borrowers.
Loan sizes and interest rates have not been announced.

stories.h: UK splits post-study work visa into two tiers from 2027
stories.p: The UK is changing its Graduate visa from January 2027: most bachelor's and master's graduates will get 18 months instead of two years, while graduates of universities with strong compliance and job records will keep two years. Nigerians are among the biggest users of the route.
body: Nigerian students planning to study in the United Kingdom will face new rules on how long they can stay and work after graduation, under changes announced in the UK government's 2026 Budget.
## What is changing

From 1 January 2027, the Graduate visa will reportedly be split into two tiers. Most bachelor's and master's graduates will be allowed 18 months to stay and work, down from two years. Graduates of universities with strong immigration compliance records and good graduate job outcomes will keep two years. Doctoral graduates will keep their existing three years. Applications submitted before 1 January 2027 will be decided under the current rules.
## Unanswered questions

The UK government has not yet published the list of qualifying universities or the exact criteria that will be used. The change partly reverses an earlier plan to cut the visa to 18 months for everyone.
## Why it matters for Nigerians

Nigeria was the third-largest source of sponsored study visas to the UK in the year to June 2026, with more than 26,000 main applicants, behind only China and India. More than 20,000 Nigerians were granted permission on the Graduate route in the same period. Prospective students are being advised to check a university's immigration compliance record and graduate employment outcomes, as well as fees and reputation.
## Background

The Graduate visa cannot be extended, so graduates who want to stay longer must switch to another route, such as the Skilled Worker visa. The UK has tightened immigration rules in recent years, including restrictions on bringing family members on student visas.
more: Most graduates will get 18 months instead of two years from January 2027.
Graduates of high-performing universities keep two years.
The list of qualifying universities has not been published.

stories.h: South-East governors urge region to back Tinubu at APC women's rally in Enugu
stories.p: The governors of Enugu, Imo and Ebonyi, and a representative of Anambra's governor, have reportedly urged South-East voters to support President Tinubu's re-election at an APC women's rally in Enugu. The call sets up a direct contest with Peter Obi in his home region.
body: Four South-East state governments have thrown their weight behind President Bola Tinubu's re-election bid, in a show of support in a region widely seen as Peter Obi's stronghold.
## What happened

At an APC Women Mega Rally and Empowerment Programme for the South-East at Okpara Square, Enugu, on Saturday, 31 October 2026, the governors reportedly urged residents to back the President and APC candidates at all levels in the January 2027 elections.
## What the governors said

Enugu Governor Peter Mbah said the region should build on the government's economic reforms rather than change course, comparing it to a sailor who does not abandon his ship mid-sea. He also described an empowerment programme for 5,000 women across the five South-East states. Imo Governor Hope Uzodimma said Igbo people were now seeing real inclusion and development under Tinubu, and that improved federal allocations had helped his state pay salaries and pensions regularly. Ebonyi Governor Francis Nwifuru praised the APC's skills programmes and denied links to any coalition outside the party. Anambra Governor Charles Soludo was represented by his deputy, Gilbert Ibezim, who said the region should repay the administration with votes. Deputy Speaker Benjamin Kalu also spoke, noting that no Igbo person had been president in six decades and praising the South East Development Commission.
## Background

Peter Obi, the NDC presidential candidate and a former Anambra governor, won most of the South East in the 2023 presidential election. He has said he would serve only one term if elected, while some APC figures argue the region should aim for a longer stay in power through alliances. Obi had not responded to the rally at the time of the report.
## What happens next
Both the APC and the NDC are expected to intensify their campaigns in the South East, which is likely to be one of the most closely watched regions in the election.
more: Governors Mbah, Uzodimma and Nwifuru spoke at the rally; Soludo was represented.
They urged the region to back Tinubu in January 2027.
The South East is seen as Peter Obi's stronghold.

stories.h: Davido and VeryDarkMan unfollow each other on Instagram as feud deepens
stories.p: Davido and VeryDarkMan have reportedly unfollowed each other on Instagram, the latest sign that their friendship has broken down. The move comes days after Kokopee spoke about the rift and Davido backed Zlatan's chart-topping song aimed at VDM.
body: The rift between Davido and social media activist VeryDarkMan (VDM) has moved to a new stage, with the two reportedly unfollowing each other on Instagram.
## What happened

Checks on Saturday, 31 October 2026, reportedly showed that Davido, who has more than 31 million followers, had removed VDM from his following list, and that VDM, who has more than 3 million followers, had done the same. Neither appears to have blocked the other, and neither has publicly explained the move.
## The build-up

The two were once close allies, but their friendship broke down earlier this year. This week, VDM's friend Kokopee said he had tried to bring them back together and that VDM felt betrayed by the singer. Davido responded with a 'cap' emoji, suggesting he disputed the account. He also congratulated rapper Zlatan Ibile on 'Inferno', a chart-topping song widely seen as a jab at VDM.
## VDM's court case
Separately, VDM announced that a criminal case brought against him by the police had been struck out, and he shared his excitement about the ruling.
## How people reacted

Fans were divided. Some praised Davido for cutting ties, while others criticised him and urged him to support VDM's charity work instead. Many said the unfollow confirmed that a reconciliation was unlikely for now.
more: Davido and VDM have reportedly unfollowed each other.
The move follows Davido's reaction to Kokopee and Zlatan's 'Inferno'.
VDM says a police case against him was struck out.

stories.h: Africa Energy Bank begins operations in Abuja with $5bn capital
stories.p: The Africa Energy Bank, set up by Afreximbank and the African Petroleum Producers' Organisation, has begun operations at its headquarters in Abuja and named Helmy Ghazi as its first president. It aims to help close a $200 billion gap in energy investment across Africa.
body: A new pan-African bank dedicated to financing energy projects has officially started work in Nigeria's capital.
## What happened

The Africa Energy Bank held its first general meeting in Abuja and named Helmy Ghazi as its first president, according to a statement by the African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) reported on Sunday, 1 November 2026. The bank has an authorised capital of $5 billion.
## What the bank will do

The bank was set up by Afreximbank and the African Petroleum Producers' Organisation (APPO) to fund oil, gas and other energy infrastructure on the continent. Afreximbank estimates that Africa needs about $200 billion in energy investment to meet its development needs. Supporters of the bank say it will help African producers finance projects at a time when many Western lenders have pulled back from funding oil and gas.
## Background

Nigeria won the bid to host the bank's headquarters, beating other African countries, and the Federal Government has promoted the institution as a sign of investor confidence. African oil producers have long complained that it is difficult to raise money for fossil fuel projects as global banks shift towards renewable energy. The bank is expected to fund a mix of projects, including gas processing, refineries and power generation.
## What it means

For Nigeria, hosting the bank could bring jobs, international meetings and closer ties with energy investors, though analysts say its success will depend on how quickly it can raise funds and start lending.
more: The bank has $5bn authorised capital and is based in Abuja.
Helmy Ghazi is its first president.
It aims to help close a $200bn energy investment gap.

stories.h: Social media clout without financial growth is a wasted opportunity: what Daniel Regha can learn from VDM's RATEL
stories.p: Daniel Regha has questioned VeryDarkMan's move from activism into business with his RATEL brand. But VDM's shift raises a bigger question for every Nigerian influencer: what are you building with all that attention?
body: Daniel Regha has weighed in on VeryDarkMan's growing RATEL business, writing on X that VDM had gone "from activist, to NGO business, to CEO" and "from criticizing business owners to joining the same businesses to make profit."

His post drew mixed reactions. One user replied that anyone who has not yet understood VDM is to be pitied, while another asked what VDM is supposed to do with the money he makes from social media: give it all away and own nothing because he is an activist?
## Influence without a business

Sometimes one wonders whether Daniel Regha sees the business opportunities sitting right in front of him. For someone who commands so much attention on X, sparks conversations almost daily and has built a considerable following, you would expect him to have turned that influence into something financially rewarding by now.
Perhaps the fear of what people will say is holding him back.
## You are only a tenant

Many influencers forget that they do not own these platforms. They are simply tenants. Facebook, X, TikTok and Instagram can suspend an account, restrict its reach or change their policies overnight, and years of gathering followers could suddenly amount to very little.
## What VDM seems to understand
VeryDarkMan appears to understand something many influencers have yet to figure out: popularity has an expiry date. The same people cheering you today may move on to another personality tomorrow.

Instead of depending entirely on public attention, he is gradually converting his influence into a business. He is introducing products, building a customer base and creating something that could keep generating income long after the social media excitement fades. That is smart thinking.
## People will always talk
Imagine spending years building an audience of hundreds of thousands, or even millions, of people, only to have nothing financially sustainable to show for it.

If you have the audience, build a business. Sell products, offer services, create something valuable and earn legitimate money from the influence you have worked hard to establish. If you sell something, people will criticise you. If you remain broke, those same people will still have something to say. The people whose opinions you fear will not come together to pay your rent, feed your family or settle your bills.
## The real question

The advice to Daniel Regha and other social media personalities is simple: stop treating online popularity as a lifetime achievement, and find a way to turn that attention into lasting value. VDM may have his critics, but his decision to venture into business deserves recognition.
Because when the followers stop cheering and the cameras stop rolling, the real question will be: what did you build with all that influence?
What do you think? Should influencers concentrate on entertaining their followers, or should they use their popularity to build businesses?
more: Daniel Regha called VDM's journey 'all direction'.
Social media users were split in their replies.
Influencers are tenants on platforms they do not own.

stories.h: US appeals court puts hold on order to reopen 2027 visa lottery
stories.p: A US appeals court has reportedly paused a lower court order that required the State Department to open registration for the 2027 Diversity Visa lottery. Tens of thousands of African hopefuls now have no confirmed date to apply while the appeal continues.
body: Hopes of an imminent opening of the US Diversity Visa lottery for 2027 have been put on hold after a federal appeals court intervened, according to reports on Sunday, 1 November 2026.
## What happened

The US Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit reportedly granted an emergency stay on 29 October, pausing an order issued by District Judge Jinsook Ohta on 14 October. That order, made in a case brought by immigration law firm Red Eagle Law against Secretary of State Marco Rubio, had required the State Department to announce registration dates, open applications and notify selected entrants by 3 December. The lower court had set 29 October for publishing registration details and 1 November for opening the application window.
## Why it was paused

The appeals judges reportedly found that the law firm had not shown that its financial interest in representing lottery winners was closely enough linked to the programme's goal of increasing immigration from under-represented countries. The court said its decision was not an endorsement of the State Department's failure to open the programme.
## Who is affected

The lottery offers up to 55,000 US immigrant visas each year to people from countries with low rates of immigration to the United States, and African applicants have long made up a large share of winners. Tens of thousands of hopefuls across the continent now have no confirmed registration date. Nigeria has been excluded from the lottery for several years because of its high number of immigrants to the US, but many Nigerians follow the programme closely and some qualify through a spouse's or parent's country of birth.
## What happens next
The registration window will remain closed until the appeal is decided or the State Department announces its own dates.
more: The Ninth Circuit paused an order to open the 2027 lottery.
The lower court had set 1 November for registration to open.
Applicants must wait for the appeal to be decided.

stories.h: Chelsea beat Manchester United 2-0 as Carrick insists he will stay in charge
stories.p: Manchester United lost 2-0 at Chelsea on Saturday, leaving them 17th in the Premier League, one point above the relegation zone. Manager Michael Carrick said he expects to remain in charge for Tuesday's Champions League game against Roma.
body: Pressure on Manchester United manager Michael Carrick has grown after another defeat in the Premier League.
## The match

Chelsea beat United 2-0 on Saturday, 31 October 2026, with both goals coming in the second half from Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer, according to reports. It was United's fourth league defeat of the season and leaves them 17th in the table, just one point above the relegation zone.
## What Carrick said

Speaking to TNT Sports after the game, Carrick was asked directly whether he expected to still be in charge for United's next match, the Champions League tie against Roma at Old Trafford on Tuesday. He reportedly answered simply that he did.
## Background

Carrick, a former United midfielder, has faced growing criticism after a poor start to the season. Reports earlier this week said the club's board had decided against sacking him for now. The club is also facing decisions over several senior defenders whose contracts expire at the end of the season, with Super Eagles defender Calvin Bassey among the players reportedly being considered as a replacement.
## What happens next
Tuesday's Champions League match against Roma is now seen as an important test for the manager. Fans are divided, with some calling for patience and others for an immediate change.
more: Rogers and Palmer scored for Chelsea in the second half.
United are 17th, a point above the relegation zone.
Carrick says he expects to be in charge against Roma.

stories.h: US Embassy warns of credible threat of attack at Moscow museum
stories.p: The US Embassy in Moscow has warned Americans of a credible threat of a mass-casualty attack at the Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve. Russia's security service said it received the information from US partners and was taking action, and the site was reportedly closed.
body: The United States Embassy in Moscow has issued an urgent warning about a possible attack at one of the Russian capital's best-known historic sites.
## What the embassy said

In a statement on Saturday, 31 October 2026, the embassy said it was aware of a credible threat of an event that could cause mass casualties at the Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve. It advised American citizens to avoid the site that day, stay alert and avoid crowds, and said the US government was coordinating with Russian authorities.
## Russia's response

Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB) confirmed it had received information from its American counterparts about possible preparations for a terrorist attack in Moscow and said it was taking appropriate action. Russian media reported that the museum reserve was temporarily closed and that police restricted access to the surrounding park.
## Background

Tsaritsyno is a large 18th-century palace and park complex in the south of Moscow, popular with tourists and families. The warning is reminiscent of March 2024, when the US Embassy warned of a possible attack on large gatherings in Moscow shortly before gunmen attacked the Crocus City Hall concert venue, killing more than 140 people. The rare cooperation between US and Russian security services comes at a time of high tension between Russia and the West over Ukraine and Europe.
## What happens next
No attack had been reported at the time of writing. Russian authorities are expected to give further updates on their security operation.
more: The embassy says there is a credible threat at the Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve.
Russia's FSB says it received the warning from US partners.
The museum was reportedly closed temporarily.

stories.h: VeryDarkMan's RATEL brand reportedly records ₦90 million in sales in one day
stories.p: VeryDarkMan and his RATEL brand have reportedly made about ₦90 million in sales in a single day, after he shared bank alerts showing a stream of customer payments. If the figure holds, it would be one of the strongest signs yet that the social media critic is turning his influence into a serious business.
body: VeryDarkMan (VDM) and his RATEL brand have reportedly recorded about ₦90 million in sales in just one day, a figure that has set social media talking about how far the activist-turned-businessman could go.

The claim followed a post showing VDM in RATEL Power branded safety gear, holding up his phone, alongside a screenshot of bank alerts. The alerts, all dated 31 October 2026, show several customer payments for RATEL products, including a 600-watt power station, with the account balance climbing above ₦83 million.
## From critic to businessman

VDM first became widely known for his social media videos and for publicly challenging powerful figures. Over time he has moved into importing products from China, building his own brand and steadily establishing himself in business. RATEL now sells items ranging from power stations to sensor lights.
## A marketing style built on openness

What stands out most is how he markets the brand. Rather than relying on traditional adverts, he brings his audience along with him. He shows them the products, explains how they work and tests them publicly, so followers are watching the business grow in real time.
Whether people like him or not, few can deny the attention he has drawn to RATEL.
## Sales are not profit

It is worth remembering that ₦90 million in sales is not ₦90 million in profit. Running a business comes with stock costs, shipping, staff, risk and plenty of other challenges, and the figure itself has not been independently confirmed.

Still, if RATEL keeps up this momentum, many observers believe it could grow into a multibillion-naira business group. Ten years from now, people may look back at these early videos and remember exactly how it all started.
## Why it matters

Nigeria needs more young people who can turn online influence into productive businesses that create jobs and last. VDM's journey, with its struggles, criticism, mistakes and determination, is playing out in full public view.
So the question is simple: do you believe RATEL can become one of Nigeria's biggest indigenous brands in the next five years?
more: Bank alerts shared online show multiple customer payments for RATEL products.
Sales figures are not the same as profit.
Could RATEL become one of Nigeria's biggest home-grown brands?

stories.h: Obasanjo and daughter Iyabo trade jokes on stage at Abeokuta symposium
stories.p: Former President Olusegun Obasanjo and his daughter, former senator Iyabo Obasanjo, drew laughter at a symposium in Abeokuta when she jokingly said she did not know him and he replied that it was already an abuse of AI. The event focused on using artificial intelligence for development.
body: Former President Olusegun Obasanjo and his daughter, former senator Iyabo Obasanjo, provided a light-hearted moment at a public event in Abeokuta, Ogun State, with a playful exchange that quickly spread online.
## What happened

At the Ajibosin Platform symposium, held at the Olusegun Obasanjo Presidential Library on Friday, 30 October 2026, Iyabo reportedly greeted the dignitaries in her opening address and acknowledged her father last, joking that he was someone she did not know. When the former President took the microphone, he responded that the abuse of artificial intelligence had already started, since his own daughter now claimed not to know her father. The audience laughed at both remarks.
## About the event

The symposium, part of the Odun Omo Olowu festival, focused on using artificial intelligence to solve grassroots problems and speed up national development. It was at the same event that Obasanjo criticised President Bola Tinubu's attitude to borrowing, saying debt destroys generations, and warned against relying too heavily on advice from foreign-trained economists.
## Background

Iyabo Obasanjo is a public health specialist who served as Ogun State Commissioner for Health and later as a senator representing Ogun Central. She is currently the PDP candidate for Ogun Central in the 2027 elections. Father and daughter have had a well-publicised strained relationship in the past, which made their friendly exchange all the more talked about.
## How people reacted
Many social media users enjoyed the moment, saying it showed a warmer side of the former President, while others joked about the role of AI in family relationships.
more: Iyabo joked she did not know her father.
Obasanjo replied that it was 'abuse of AI'.
The symposium focused on AI for development.

stories.h: Pro-Tinubu group warns APC that Imo West row could cost it South East support
stories.p: The Renewed Hope Foot Soldiers for Tinubu has warned that the fight over the APC's Imo West Senate ticket could weaken the party in the South East. The group wants Governor Hope Uzodimma to be allowed to pursue his ambitions and called for dialogue, after a court recognised Rochas Okorocha as the candidate.
body: A pro-Tinubu support group has warned the All Progressives Congress (APC) that the dispute over its candidate for the Imo West Senatorial District could hurt the party in the South East ahead of 2027.
## What the group said

In a statement signed by its national president, Gbenga Owojori, and reported on Saturday, 31 October 2026, the Renewed Hope Foot Soldiers for Tinubu reacted to the Federal High Court ruling that recognised former governor Rochas Okorocha, rather than Governor Hope Uzodimma, as the APC candidate for Imo West. The group argued that shutting out candidates from the South East could weaken the coalition President Bola Tinubu needs for re-election.
## Its demands

The group called on party leaders to resolve the matter through inclusive dialogue and transparent party processes, and said Uzodimma should be given a fair chance to pursue his ambitions, including a possible bid for the Senate presidency. It also made claims, which it did not support with evidence, that some senior political figures were working against Uzodimma. Those named have not responded to the claims.
## Background

Okorocha went to court claiming he won the APC primary on 18 May, while the party's returning officer declared Uzodimma the winner. The court ordered INEC to publish Okorocha's name, and former APC national chairman Abdullahi Ganduje later visited Okorocha to congratulate him. The case also raises the question of whether a sitting governor can contest a Senate seat while still in office. Uzodimma has not said publicly whether he will appeal.
## What happens next
The dispute is expected to continue in court and within the party, with both camps seeking the backing of the national leadership.
more: The group says the row could cost the APC South East support.
It wants Uzodimma to be allowed to pursue his ambitions.
A court recognised Okorocha as the APC candidate.

stories.h: Akwa Ibom announces 13th-month pension bonus and ₦10,000 payment for retirees
stories.p: Akwa Ibom Governor Umo Eno has announced a 13th-month pension bonus for all pensioners in the state, plus a ₦10,000 welfare payment to be paid with November pensions. He said ₦100 billion of an inherited ₦111 billion gratuity backlog has been cleared.
body: Pensioners in Akwa Ibom State are set to receive an extra month's pension, Governor Umo Eno has announced.
## What was announced

Speaking at the Ibom Hall Grounds in Uyo, in remarks reported on Saturday, 31 October 2026, the governor said all pensioners in the state would receive a 13th-month pension bonus. He also announced a separate ₦10,000 welfare payment, which will be paid together with November 2026 pensions. The exact amount and payment date of the 13th-month bonus were not stated in reports.
## Clearing the backlog

The governor reportedly said his government had paid ₦100 billion of a ₦111 billion gratuity backlog it inherited and planned to clear the remainder before the end of its first term. He also urged pensioners aged 65 and above to register for the state's free health insurance scheme for older people.
## Background

At the event, the Nigeria Union of Pensioners presented the governor with a merit award. Unpaid pensions and gratuities are a long-standing problem in many Nigerian states, and retirees have often protested over delays. Some states have recently announced extra payments to help workers and pensioners cope with rising living costs, while the Federal Government this week unveiled a ₦50,000 monthly cash relief scheme for vulnerable households.
## How people reacted
Pensioners welcomed the announcement, while some residents called on other states to follow the example.
more: All pensioners in the state will get a 13th-month bonus.
A ₦10,000 welfare payment comes with November pensions.
₦100bn of a ₦111bn gratuity backlog has reportedly been paid.

stories.h: Funke Akindele says 'Everybody Loves Jenifa' is her most expensive film
stories.p: Funke Akindele has reportedly named 'Everybody Loves Jenifa' as the most expensive film she has produced, citing travel to Ghana for the cast and crew and the cost of building her own sets. She spoke in a CNN interview about her filmmaking career.
body: Nollywood's top-grossing filmmaker Funke Akindele has revealed which of her films cost the most to make.
## What she said

In an interview with CNN journalist Larry Madowo, reported on Saturday, 31 October 2026, Funke Akindele reportedly named 'Everybody Loves Jenifa' as the most expensive film she has produced. She said the costs came from flying the entire cast and crew to Ghana, filming some scenes at a high-end resort, and building sets back in Nigeria. She explained that she prefers to build her own sets rather than shoot in other people's homes. She did not give a figure for the budget.
## Box office success

Akindele said the film performed well both in cinemas and on streaming platforms. 'Everybody Loves Jenifa', released in December 2024, became one of the highest-grossing Nollywood films of all time, continuing her run of record-breaking releases that includes 'Battle on Buka Street' and 'A Tribe Called Judah'.
## Background

Akindele is best known for the Jenifa character, which began in 2008 and grew into a television series and several films. She is currently promoting her next film, 'The Four', for which she recently announced a partnership with Facebook. Fellow actress Toyin Abraham this week shared an old TikTok collaboration, which fans read as a response to Funke's announcement.
## How fans reacted
Fans praised her ambition and investment in quality productions, saying her success has raised the standard for Nollywood films.
more: She named 'Everybody Loves Jenifa' as her most expensive film.
Costs included flying the cast to Ghana and building sets.
She did not give a budget figure.

stories.h: US court rejects bid to seek evidence from Tinubu in FOIA case, Presidency says
stories.p: A federal court in Washington has reportedly refused a request by US researcher Aaron Greenspan to seek evidence from President Bola Tinubu and a lobbying firm in his records lawsuit against the FBI and DEA. The Presidency welcomed the ruling, while the underlying case continues.
body: A United States federal court has turned down an attempt to obtain evidence from President Bola Tinubu as part of a long-running records lawsuit, according to a statement from the Presidency on Saturday, 31 October 2026.
## What the court decided

The case, before the US District Court for the District of Columbia, is a Freedom of Information Act lawsuit filed by American researcher Aaron Greenspan against the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) and the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA). On 30 October, the court reportedly denied Greenspan's request for limited discovery from President Tinubu and the lobbying firm DCI Group, which he had linked to alleged cyberattacks on his website. The court found the request was not relevant enough to the main records dispute. It also rejected a request by a third party to file a friend-of-the-court brief, refused a related request for judicial notice, and denied Greenspan's motion for summary judgment, meaning the main case continues.
## The Presidency's reaction

The President's adviser on information and strategy, Bayo Onanuga, announced the development. Lawyers quoted in the statement said the ruling kept the case focused on the issues properly before the court and set clear limits on what it would consider.
## Background

Greenspan has for several years sought the release of US government records he says relate to investigations involving the President in the 1990s. The President's lawyers have consistently opposed the release of the records, and the Presidency has dismissed the claims linked to them. The case has drawn wide attention in Nigeria, particularly from opposition supporters.
## What happens next
The FOIA case itself will continue, and further rulings are expected. Greenspan had not publicly responded to the decision at the time of the report.
more: The court denied a request for discovery from Tinubu and DCI Group.
It also denied Greenspan's motion for summary judgment.
The underlying records case continues.

stories.h: Content creator De Peters questions how VeryDarkMan presents his power station business
stories.p: Content creator De Peters has criticised VeryDarkMan for presenting his power station venture as a favour to Nigerians when he is selling the units for profit. He also accused VDM of criticising other influencers for promotions while advertising his own products.
body: Social media activist VeryDarkMan (VDM) is facing fresh criticism over his power station business, this time from content creator De Peters.
## What De Peters said

In comments reported on Saturday, 31 October 2026, De Peters reportedly asked why VDM was acting as though he was giving Nigerians free power stations, when he was in fact selling them to make money. He argued that VDM often criticises other influencers for promoting cryptocurrency, betting platforms and other products, yet was now promoting his own goods. He also said other businesses already sell power stations in Nigeria, some with similar capacity and specifications at lower prices.
## Background

VDM has spent recent weeks promoting his Ratel power stations, imported from China, with videos from a warehouse and demonstrations of the units. He has said buyers will be limited to two units each and has clashed with businessman Blord, whom he accuses of copying the idea. Other commentators have praised VDM for bringing more affordable solar options to Nigerians, with one claiming that prices of power stations have fallen since the Ratel brand launched. The debate comes as federal agencies warn celebrities they will be held responsible for promoting fraudulent products, although there is no suggestion that VDM's products are fraudulent.
## How people reacted

The comments sparked a wider conversation about influencer marketing. Some users agreed that VDM should not present a business as charity, while his supporters said he was offering a useful product at a fair price. VDM had not publicly responded at the time of the report.
more: De Peters says VDM is selling, not giving away, power stations.
He accuses VDM of criticising others' promotions while advertising his own.
VDM had not responded at the time of reporting.

stories.h: Three kidnapped Zamfara clerics rescued after weeks in captivity
stories.p: Security forces have reportedly rescued three of six Islamic clerics who were kidnapped in Zamfara State in September while travelling to a prayer session for President Tinubu. The clerics are said to be unharmed and will be handed over to the state government.
body: Three Islamic clerics who were kidnapped in Zamfara State more than six weeks ago have been freed, according to reports on Saturday, 31 October 2026.
## What happened

The clerics were among six imams abducted on 12 September 2026 on the Dakko–Damri road in Bakura Local Government Area, near Sububu Forest, while travelling to Talata Mafara for a prayer gathering for President Bola Tinubu's government. Their kidnappers reportedly demanded a ransom of ₦30 million.
## The rescue

The three were reportedly rescued through intelligence-led operations by the Office of the National Security Adviser and the Department of State Services, working with the police. They were said to be unharmed and in stable condition after medical checks and security debriefings, and will be handed over to the Zamfara State Government to be reunited with their families. The fate of the other three clerics was not reported, and it was not said whether any ransom was paid.
## Background

Zamfara is one of the states worst affected by banditry in the North West, with frequent kidnappings on rural roads and in villages. Security agencies have stepped up operations in the region, but abductions for ransom remain common. Insecurity is a key issue in the 2027 election campaign, and opposition candidates have promised tougher action against kidnappers.
## What happens next
Security agencies say efforts are continuing to secure the release of the remaining captives.
more: Three of six clerics kidnapped on 12 September have been freed.
They were rescued by the DSS and the NSA's office, working with police.
The fate of the other three has not been reported.

stories.h: Joke Silva thanks supporters as 40-day mourning for Olu Jacobs ends
stories.p: Veteran actress Joke Silva has thanked Nigerians for their prayers, visits and support as the family marks the end of the 40-day mourning period for her husband, the late screen legend Olu Jacobs.
body: Veteran Nollywood actress Joke Silva has issued a heartfelt message of thanks as her family marks the end of the 40-day mourning period for her late husband, Olu Jacobs.
## What she wrote

In an Instagram post on Saturday, 31 October 2026, accompanied by a photo of herself and her husband, Joke Silva wrote on behalf of the Jacobs family to thank everyone who had supported them. She thanked those who sent prayers, messages and calls, those who visited in person, and those who gave gifts or contributed towards the funeral. She said the 40 days had come and gone, and that the family was humbled and deeply grateful. She signed the message as Ajoke Silva, on behalf of the Jacobs family.
## Who was Olu Jacobs

Olu Jacobs was one of the most respected actors in Nigerian film history, with a career spanning stage, television and cinema in Nigeria and the United Kingdom. He appeared in many Nollywood classics and international productions and was widely regarded as a father figure in the industry. He and Joke Silva, herself an acclaimed actress and co-founder of the Lufodo Academy of Performing Arts, were one of Nollywood's most admired couples.
## How fans reacted
Fans and colleagues responded with messages of love and prayers for the family, praising Joke Silva for her strength and dignity during the period of mourning.
more: Joke Silva thanked supporters on behalf of the Jacobs family.
She said the family was humbled and deeply grateful.
Olu Jacobs was one of Nollywood's most respected actors.

stories.h: Two suspected Ebola cases in Adamawa test negative, NCDC says
stories.p: The NCDC says two suspected Ebola cases in Yola, Adamawa State, tested negative after two rounds of laboratory testing. Nigeria still has only one confirmed case, an imported case in the FCT, and the public has been urged to rely on official information.
body: The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) has announced two suspected cases of Ebola virus disease in the North-East of the country.
## What the NCDC said

In a social media post on Saturday, 31 October 2026, the NCDC said the two cases were suspected only and had not been confirmed. Both people have been isolated, laboratory tests are being carried out, and health workers have begun identifying and listing everyone who came into contact with them. The agency did not say which states the cases are in or give details about the patients, and said it would provide updates as verified information becomes available.
## Advice to the public

The NCDC urged Nigerians to wash their hands thoroughly and often, improve sanitation and follow guidance from health authorities. Health officials generally advise anyone with symptoms such as sudden fever, weakness, vomiting or unexplained bleeding, especially after contact with a sick person or recent travel to an affected country, to seek medical care quickly and avoid self-medication.
## Update: cases test negative

On Sunday, 1 November, the NCDC said the two suspected cases, in Yola, Adamawa State, had tested negative in two separate rounds of laboratory testing. The agency said it had worked with the Adamawa State Government on the investigation, that the index case in the Federal Capital Territory remains Nigeria's only laboratory-confirmed case, and that no further confirmed cases have been reported. It urged the public to stay calm and to rely only on official sources.
## Background

Nigeria recorded one confirmed imported Ebola case this month in a traveller who had recently been to Uganda. That patient was evacuated to Switzerland for treatment, and dozens of contacts were monitored. The wider outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, began in the Democratic Republic of Congo in May and has now passed 10,000 confirmed cases, with nearly 5,000 deaths. Africa CDC warned this week that the continent is not winning the fight against the virus.
## What happens next

Health officials say surveillance will continue, and anyone with symptoms such as fever, severe weakness, vomiting or unexplained bleeding, especially after travel or contact with a sick person, should seek care quickly and tell health workers their history.
more: Both suspected cases in Yola tested negative twice.
Nigeria still has only one confirmed, imported case.
The NCDC urges people to rely on official information.

stories.h: Atiku condemns attacks on Sowore and Sokoto ADC candidate, demands probe
stories.p: ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar has condemned the recent attacks on Omoyele Sowore and Sokoto ADC governorship candidate Manir Dan'iya, blaming supporters of the ruling party. He demanded transparent investigations and a guarantee of a free and fair election.
body: Former Vice President Atiku Abubakar has spoken out against a string of reported attacks on opposition politicians, accusing supporters of the ruling party of trying to intimidate rivals ahead of the 2027 elections.
## What he said

In a statement on X on Saturday, 31 October 2026, Atiku, the presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), condemned the assault on AAC presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore in Ado-Ekiti and the attack on the convoy of Manir Muhammad Dan'iya, the ADC governorship candidate in Sokoto State. He also criticised what he said was harassment of residents in Sokoto for wearing ADC-branded clothing, and described the unexplained disappearance of some social media influencers as a warning sign.
## Who he blamed

Atiku blamed loyalists and enforcers of the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC), noting that the attacks happened while President Bola Tinubu was abroad on a religious pilgrimage. He described the violence as a sign of desperation and said the ADC would resist any attempt to wipe out political opposition.
## His demands

He called on the federal government to order immediate and transparent investigations into the attacks on Sowore and Dan'iya, and to guarantee a free, fair and competitive environment for the 2027 elections.
## Background

Sowore says he and his team were attacked at a restaurant in Ado-Ekiti on Friday; police deny he was kidnapped and have ordered an investigation. Dan'iya says his convoy was blocked and shot at near the Sokoto airport on Friday night. The APC and the Sokoto State Government had not responded to Atiku's statement at the time of the report.
more: Atiku blames ruling-party loyalists for the attacks.
He wants transparent investigations into the Sowore and Dan'iya incidents.
The APC had not responded at the time of reporting.

stories.h: EFCC, ICPC and FCCPC warn celebrities they will be held accountable for promoting scams
stories.p: Nigeria's anti-graft and consumer protection agencies have warned celebrities and influencers that they will be held responsible if they promote fraudulent products, such as crypto schemes and fake loan apps. They urged stars to check products with regulators before taking endorsement deals.
body: Nigerian celebrities and social media influencers who advertise fraudulent products could face consequences, three federal agencies have warned.
## What happened

At a joint stakeholder meeting in Abuja on Friday, 30 October 2026, the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission (FCCPC), the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) and the Independent Corrupt Practices and Other Related Offences Commission (ICPC) reportedly said they would no longer accept claims of ignorance from celebrities whose endorsements lead Nigerians into scams.
## What the agencies said

FCCPC Executive Vice Chairman Tunji Bello said celebrities would be held accountable for the products they promote. EFCC Chairman Ola Olukoyede warned that influencers who promote fraud would be treated as accomplices, saying the trust fans place in them must not be abused. The ICPC said fake endorsements undermine consumer confidence and fuel corruption. The agencies said skit makers, musicians and actors had promoted crypto schemes and fake loan apps that cost many Nigerians billions of naira.
## Advice

The agencies urged celebrities to check products with regulators such as NAFDAC, the Securities and Exchange Commission and the FCCPC before signing endorsement deals. They also asked members of the public to report suspicious products and adverts that seem too good to be true.
## Background

Several high-profile investment schemes promoted online have collapsed in recent years, leaving thousands of investors out of pocket. Some entertainers who advertised such schemes later faced public anger, and regulators have repeatedly warned about unregistered investment platforms and loan apps. The FCCPC publishes an updated list of approved digital lenders.
more: The agencies say celebrities will be held accountable for fraudulent endorsements.
Crypto schemes and fake loan apps were singled out.
Stars are urged to verify products with regulators first.

stories.h: US congressman introduces bill to stop lobbyists working for Nigeria
stories.p: US Representative Barry Moore has introduced a bill that would bar American lobbyists from being paid to represent Nigeria while it remains designated a Country of Particular Concern over religious freedom. He accuses the Nigerian government of paying lobbyists to counter criticism over attacks on Christians.
body: A United States congressman has introduced legislation aimed at stopping American lobbying firms from working for the Nigerian government.
## What the bill does

Representative Barry Moore introduced H.R. 10939, which would bar people and firms in the United States from accepting payment to lobby on Nigeria's behalf for as long as Nigeria is designated a Country of Particular Concern (CPC) for religious freedom violations. Firms that take such payments during that period could face sanctions. The bill was reported on Saturday, 31 October 2026, and has been referred to the House Committee on Foreign Affairs.
## Why Moore introduced it

Moore reportedly accused the Nigerian government of paying expensive lobbyists in Washington to play down the persecution of Christians in the country. The allegations of persecution are disputed by the Nigerian government, which has said that insecurity affects people of all faiths and is driven by terrorism, banditry and communal conflicts.
## Background

The United States designated Nigeria a Country of Particular Concern, a label for countries accused of severe violations of religious freedom. The designation has strained relations between the two countries, and the Nigerian government has hired lobbying firms in Washington to present its position. The issue gained new attention this week after a Christian woman was convicted in Borno State over converting an adult, a case criticised by Christian groups.
## What happens next
The bill must pass through committee and both houses of Congress before it can become law. The Nigerian government had not responded publicly at the time of the report.
more: The bill would bar paid lobbying for Nigeria while it is a CPC.
Moore accuses Nigeria of paying lobbyists to counter criticism.
The bill has been referred to the House Foreign Affairs Committee.

stories.h: VeryDarkMan unveils RATEL Sensor Light, an affordable motion-activated light for Nigerian homes
stories.p: VeryDarkMan has added a motion-activated sensor light to his growing RATEL brand, priced at ₦4,200 for the small size and ₦9,000 for the big size. The light switches on automatically when it detects movement, which could help households during power cuts and add a little security around the compound.
body: VeryDarkMan (VDM) has unveiled another product under his growing RATEL brand, and this time it is something many Nigerian households may find useful, especially with the country's unpredictable electricity supply.
The new product is the RATEL Sensor Light, a motion-activated light that comes on automatically when it detects movement.
## How much it costs
According to VDM, the sensor light comes in two sizes: the small size costs ₦4,200, while the big size costs ₦9,000.
## Why it could be useful

Anyone living in Nigeria knows how frustrating the electricity situation can be. Imagine NEPA suddenly takes light at midnight and everywhere goes dark. You need to leave your bedroom, walk downstairs, check on your children or find your way outside to switch on the generator. Before you even find your torchlight, you have already knocked your leg against a chair.

This is where a sensor light could come in handy. It can be placed along staircases, corridors, bedroom entrances, wardrobes, storerooms and other dark corners of the house. Once it detects movement within its range, it switches on automatically, with no need to search for a wall switch in the dark.
## A possible security benefit
The light could also help around entrances, gates and backyards. If somebody quietly approaches that area at night, the space around the sensor suddenly becomes bright.
Of course, a sensor light cannot replace proper home security, but it may help discourage unwanted visitors and make movement around a compound more noticeable.
VDM also explained that the product comes with different lighting colour options, including multicolour settings.
## What buyers should check

At ₦4,200 for the smaller version, some households may find it affordable enough to install several units: one on the staircase, another in the corridor and perhaps two around the entrance. However, buyers should check the battery life, charging method, weather resistance and detection range before deciding where to install it.
## A growing RATEL range

What stands out about this latest RATEL product is the idea behind it. VDM appears to be paying attention to the everyday inconveniences Nigerians face, especially those caused by poor electricity supply. From power stations to smaller household gadgets, he is gradually expanding his product range.

There is something worth appreciating about businesses that identify ordinary problems and offer affordable solutions. You don't always need to spend hundreds of thousands of naira to make your home more comfortable, and sometimes even a small gadget can save you the stress of walking around in darkness.
Imagine having four of these lights around your house. NEPA takes light, but as you move around, the lights come on automatically. Small enjoyment!
What do you think about the new RATEL Sensor Light? At ₦4,200 and ₦9,000, would you buy one for your home?
more: The small RATEL Sensor Light costs ₦4,200 and the big one ₦9,000.
It switches on automatically when it detects movement.
It comes with different colour options, including multicolour settings.

stories.h: "2027 election has already been rigged": journalist Seun Okinbaloye raises alarm
stories.p: Popular TV journalist Seun Okinbaloye has reportedly claimed that the 2027 general election has already been rigged, with reports linking his warning to concerns about flaws in the voter register. The claim has reopened the debate about whether INEC can deliver a credible poll.
body: With Nigeria's 2027 general elections still ahead, popular television journalist Seun Okinbaloye has raised a serious concern about the credibility of the electoral process.
## What he said
In a statement now circulating widely online, Okinbaloye reportedly said the 2027 election has already been rigged. Reports link his warning to concerns about flaws in the national voter register.
The allegation raises troubling questions about Nigeria's democracy and about whether citizens will be able to freely choose their leaders.
## Why it matters
The claim comes at a time when public confidence in Nigeria's electoral system remains a major issue, especially after the controversies that followed previous elections.

For millions of Nigerians, the concern goes beyond which political party wins or loses. The bigger question is whether the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) can guarantee a transparent, credible and fair election in 2027.
## A claim, not proof
However, the allegation should not be mistaken for established evidence that the election has been manipulated. A claim this serious needs clear facts and proper investigation.

If Nigerians are already questioning the credibility of an election that has not yet taken place, INEC and the relevant authorities have a responsibility to address those concerns before voters head to the polls.
Democracy loses its meaning when citizens begin to believe that election results are decided before voting begins.
What do you think? Can Nigerians still trust INEC to conduct a free and fair election in 2027?
more: Reports link Okinbaloye's warning to concerns about the voter register.
No evidence has yet been presented publicly that the 2027 election has been manipulated.
Nigerians are calling on INEC to address the concerns before the polls.

stories.h: Christian woman reportedly jailed 14 years in Borno after Muslim woman converts to Christianity
stories.p: A Borno State High Court has reportedly sentenced Liyatu Samuel Dawa, a Christian woman, to 14 years in prison after an adult Muslim woman converted to Christianity. The convert reportedly told the court she changed her faith willingly, but Dawa was convicted under a section of the state penal code that deals with depriving a parent of lawful custody of a child.
body: A Christian woman identified as Liyatu Samuel Dawa has reportedly been sentenced to 14 years in prison by a Borno State High Court following the conversion of an adult Muslim woman to Christianity.
## What the reports say
According to reports, the Muslim woman testified in court that she willingly embraced Christianity and was not forced or threatened by anyone.

Dawa was reportedly convicted under Section 210 of the Borno State Penal Code, which deals with depriving a parent of the lawful custody of a child. She reportedly received the maximum term of 14 years without the option of a fine, and is said to have pleaded for leniency.
## What is still unclear

The full circumstances of the conviction remain unclear. It has not been explained publicly how a custody charge applies to the conversion of an adult, and there has been no statement yet from the Borno State judiciary or government. It is also not yet known whether Dawa will appeal.

Christian advocacy groups have described the sentence as punishment for sharing her faith and a miscarriage of justice. They say Dawa is in custody and that her family has gone into hiding after receiving threats.
## Religious freedom and the Constitution

The case has raised concerns about religious freedom and how the law is being applied. Section 38 of Nigeria's Constitution guarantees every citizen the freedom to practise, change and share their religion or belief.
Many Nigerians argue that this freedom must apply equally to everyone, whether they are Christian, Muslim or of another faith, and are calling for the judgment to be reviewed by a higher court.
What do you think? Should this conviction be reviewed on appeal, and how can Nigeria make sure religious freedom is protected for everyone?
more: The convert reportedly testified that she changed her religion willingly.
Dawa was reportedly convicted under Section 210 of the Borno State Penal Code.
No statement has yet come from the Borno State judiciary or government.

stories.h: Burna Boy's 'For Everybody' campaign film wins 15 awards
stories.p: 'For Everybody', a sports and music campaign film starring Burna Boy, Asisat Oshoala and Kenneth Omeruo, has reportedly won 15 prizes at the 2026 w3 Awards, including a gold award. The film was directed by Dave Meyers and released in January.
body: A campaign film featuring Burna Boy and several of Africa's best-known footballers has picked up a string of international awards.
## What happened

'For Everybody', made by Sporty Group's production arm Sporty Studios together with RadicalMedia, reportedly won 15 awards at the 2026 w3 Awards, according to reports on Saturday, 31 October 2026. It won a gold award in the creator and brand collaboration category, as well as 14 silver awards in categories including music video, cinematography, brand storytelling, branded content, and sports and entertainment.
## About the film

The film was directed by Dave Meyers, an American director best known for his music videos with major global stars, and was released in January 2026. It brings together music and sport to celebrate African talent and culture. Alongside Burna Boy, it features Nigerian football stars Asisat Oshoala and Kenneth Omeruo, as well as Spain's Nico Williams, France's Eduardo Camavinga, Ghana legend Michael Essien, Kenya's Victor Wanyama and South African rugby star Cheslin Kolbe.
## Background

The w3 Awards recognise creative work in digital media, including websites, videos and online campaigns. Burna Boy, a Grammy winner, has increasingly worked on projects linking music and sport, and recently presented the Socrates Award at this year's Ballon d'Or ceremony. Oshoala is one of Africa's most decorated female footballers, having won the African Women's Footballer of the Year award a record number of times.
## How fans reacted
Fans celebrated the recognition online, saying the film showed how African music and sport can work together to reach global audiences.
more: The film won one gold and 14 silver awards.
It was directed by Dave Meyers.
It also features Nico Williams, Camavinga and Michael Essien.

stories.h: Manchester United reportedly eyeing Super Eagles defender Calvin Bassey
stories.p: Manchester United are reportedly interested in Fulham and Super Eagles defender Calvin Bassey as a possible replacement for Lisandro Martinez. Bassey's contract is said to run out at the end of the season, and several other European clubs are also said to be watching him.
body: Super Eagles defender Calvin Bassey is reportedly attracting interest from Manchester United, according to transfer reports on Saturday, 31 October 2026.
## What is being reported

United are said to be considering Bassey as a possible replacement for Argentine defender Lisandro Martinez, whose contract is reported to expire at the end of the season. Martinez is said to be open to leaving Old Trafford, with Barcelona reportedly making enquiries. Luke Shaw and Harry Maguire are also said to be out of contract next summer, which could leave United needing several defenders.
## Bassey's situation

Bassey has been one of Fulham's most consistent players this season. His contract at Craven Cottage reportedly runs out at the end of the season, although Fulham are said to have an option to extend it by a year and would prefer to agree a new deal. Because his contract is running down, he could be available for a relatively low fee. Newcastle United, Everton, Inter Milan, Borussia Dortmund and RB Leipzig are also reportedly monitoring him.
## Background

Bassey, who can play at centre-back or left-back, joined Fulham from Ajax in 2023 after earlier spells at Rangers. He has become a regular for the Super Eagles and is valued for his pace and versatility. Manchester United, managed by Michael Carrick, have made a slow start to the season.
## What happens next
No formal offer has been reported, and any move is unlikely before the January transfer window at the earliest.
more: United reportedly see Bassey as a possible Martinez replacement.
His Fulham contract reportedly expires at the end of the season.
Newcastle, Inter and Dortmund are also said to be interested.

stories.h: Tinubu's daughter warns voters against Atiku and Obi at Abuja launch
stories.p: Iyaloja-General Folasade Tinubu-Ojo, the President's daughter, has reportedly urged Nigerians not to back Atiku Abubakar or Peter Obi in 2027, saying either would reverse the government's progress. She spoke at the launch of a pro-Tinubu market women's movement in Abuja.
body: Mujidat Folasade Tinubu-Ojo, the daughter of President Bola Tinubu and Iyaloja-General of Nigeria, has waded into the 2027 presidential race with a warning to voters about two of her father's main rivals.
## What she said

Speaking at the launch of the Iyaloja General Movement for Renewed Hope Initiatives at Eagle Square in Abuja on Thursday, 29 October 2026, Tinubu-Ojo reportedly urged Nigerians not to support Atiku Abubakar of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) or Peter Obi of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC). She argued that if either of them won, they would undo the progress made by the current government and set the country back. The remarks were reported on Saturday, 31 October.
## The movement

The new group is meant to mobilise market women and traders across the country to support President Tinubu's re-election. As Iyaloja-General, Tinubu-Ojo is the ceremonial head of market women's associations nationwide, a role her father's supporters see as a valuable link to grassroots voters.
## Background

Several pro-Tinubu groups have been launched in recent weeks, including a two-million-man march announced by Atiku's son, Abba, and the PBAT Door-to-Door Movement backed by Tompolo. Atiku and Obi are both campaigning hard, and the debate over the economy, rising prices and the government's borrowing has dominated the race so far. Neither the ADC nor the NDC had responded to her comments at the time of the report.
## How people reacted
APC supporters welcomed the launch, while opposition supporters accused the President's family of turning a traditional market leadership role into a campaign platform.
more: Tinubu-Ojo says Atiku or Obi would reverse the government's progress.
She launched a market women's movement for Tinubu in Abuja.
The ADC and NDC had not responded at the time of reporting.

stories.h: Adamawa APC inaugurates 3,000-member campaign council, receives ADC and Labour defectors
stories.p: Adamawa Governor Ahmadu Fintiri has reportedly inaugurated a campaign council of more than 3,000 members for the APC ahead of 2027, with retired General Buba Marwa as co-chairman. Defectors from the ADC and Labour Party were also received at the event in Yola.
body: The All Progressives Congress (APC) in Adamawa State has inaugurated a campaign council of more than 3,000 members for the 2027 general elections, according to reports on Saturday, 31 October 2026.
## What happened

Governor Ahmadu Umaru Fintiri reportedly inaugurated the council at the Banquet Hall of Government House in Yola on Thursday, 29 October. Retired General Buba Marwa was named co-chairman, and the council includes representatives from the state's three senatorial zones and its communities. At the same event, a group of defectors from the African Democratic Congress (ADC) and the Labour Party was received into the APC and presented to the state party chairman, Hamza Bello Madagali, by the party's North-East national vice chairman, Idris Shuaibu.
## What was said

Speakers reportedly said the party would leave nothing to chance in its bid to win the state, and Fintiri warned that anti-party behaviour would not be tolerated. Madagali acknowledged that some stakeholders had been left off the initial list and appealed for patience.
## Background

Adamawa is the home state of former Vice President Atiku Abubakar, the ADC presidential candidate, which makes the contest there especially significant. Buba Marwa is a former military governor of Lagos State and has headed the National Drug Law Enforcement Agency. Party switching has been common across the country in the run-up to the elections, with governors and lawmakers moving between parties.
## What happens next
The council is expected to begin campaigning across the state's local government areas in the coming weeks.
more: The council has more than 3,000 members, with Buba Marwa as co-chairman.
Defectors from the ADC and Labour Party were received.
Adamawa is Atiku's home state.

stories.h: Toyin Abraham's throwback TikTok post sparks talk of rivalry with Funke Akindele
stories.p: Toyin Abraham has shared an old TikTok collaboration from her film 'OverSabi Aunty' and said she looks forward to more ahead of her December release 'Bestie'. Fans linked the post to Funke Akindele's new Facebook partnership for 'The Four', reviving talk of a rivalry.
body: Nollywood actress and filmmaker Toyin Abraham has once again found herself at the centre of talk about a rivalry with Funke Akindele, after a social media post that many fans read as a response to her colleague.
## What she posted

On Friday, 30 October 2026, Toyin Abraham shared on Instagram a throwback clip of a TikTok collaboration she did while promoting her earlier film, 'OverSabi Aunty'. In the caption, she said she was looking forward to more collaborations ahead of her new film, 'Bestie', which is due in cinemas in December 2026.
## Why fans linked it to Funke

The post came just days after Funke Akindele announced a partnership with Facebook for her new film, 'The Four'. Many fans interpreted Toyin's post as a subtle reminder that she had worked with a major platform first, although she did not mention Funke, and her intention has not been confirmed.
## Background

The two actresses are among the most successful filmmakers in Nollywood, and fans have long compared their box office results. Toyin has also faced accusations of copying Funke's ideas, which she has denied. In the past she has spoken warmly about Funke, congratulating her and calling her the winner of their rivalry after one of Funke's films crossed ₦1 billion at the box office.
## How people reacted

Reactions were divided. Critics questioned the timing of the post and accused her of seeking attention, while her supporters said she had every right to talk about her own past work. Funke Akindele has not commented.
more: Toyin shared an old TikTok collaboration from 'OverSabi Aunty'.
Fans linked it to Funke Akindele's Facebook deal for 'The Four'.

stories.h: Sokoto ADC governorship candidate says his convoy was attacked near airport
stories.p: Manir Muhammad Dan'iya, the ADC governorship candidate in Sokoto State, says his convoy was blocked and shot at near the Sokoto airport on Friday night, damaging his vehicles. He blames state security personnel, while police say anyone found responsible will face the law.
body: The African Democratic Congress (ADC) candidate for governor of Sokoto State, Manir Muhammad Dan'iya, has alleged that his convoy was attacked near the Sultan Abubakar III International Airport in Sokoto on Friday night, 30 October 2026.
## What he says happened

According to his media aide, Aminu Abdullahi, the incident happened at about 9pm, shortly after Dan'iya had seen off former governor Aminu Waziri Tambuwal at the airport. He alleged that members of the Sokoto State Marshal and Community Guard blocked the convoy, saying they were acting on orders to keep ADC members out of the state. He said efforts to calm the situation failed before shots were fired. Dan'iya reportedly escaped unhurt, but his bulletproof vehicles were damaged, and he said two Department of State Services officers attached to his security team were taken away. He also said he had noticed unusual deployments at several entry points into the state earlier in the day.
## Official response

The Sokoto State Police Command spokesperson, DSP Ahmad Rufae, said the command would take necessary action and that anyone found responsible would face the law. The Sokoto State Government and the Marshal and Community Guard had not publicly responded at the time of the report, and the allegations have not been independently verified.
## What he is asking for

Dan'iya reported the matter to the state Commissioner of Police and asked the Inspector-General of Police and the head of the DSS to investigate and secure the release of the two officers. He also called on the state government to explain the alleged orders.
## Background

The incident is the latest in a string of reported attacks on opposition figures as campaigning for the January 2027 elections intensifies. On the same day, AAC presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore said he was attacked in Ado-Ekiti, and an APC rally in Katsina was disrupted earlier this week.
more: Dan'iya says his convoy was blocked and shot at; he was not hurt.
He blames state security personnel; the state government has not responded.

stories.h: Obi promises to go into the bush himself to rescue kidnap victims if elected
stories.p: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi has reportedly told a rally in Bayelsa State that he would personally go into forests to rescue kidnap victims if he becomes president. He also promised free primary education and at least 10,000MW of electricity, and criticised President Tinubu's foreign trips.
body: Peter Obi, the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), has reportedly promised to personally lead efforts to rescue kidnap victims if he is elected in 2027.
## What he said

Speaking at a campaign rally in Bayelsa State on Friday, 30 October 2026, Obi said that if anyone kidnapped schoolchildren or anyone else under his government, he would go into the bush himself. He said he had recently travelled by road through several states, including Enugu, Kogi, Nasarawa and Ebonyi, and that Nigeria's roads must be made safe. He said his government would start by uniting the country so that no region or group felt left out.
## Other promises

Obi reportedly pledged that public money would be managed openly, that an NDC government would work with states to make primary education free, and that it would aim to generate, transmit and distribute at least 10,000 megawatts of electricity. He claimed current supply is far lower.
## Criticism of Tinubu

Obi criticised President Bola Tinubu for not visiting Bayelsa, where oil was first discovered in Nigeria, and repeated his claim that the President spends a large part of the year abroad. The Presidency has previously rejected such claims, and had not responded to the latest remarks at the time of the report.
## Background

Obi has held a series of town halls and rallies this week, including in Nasarawa, where he said election riggers would be jailed, and in Ebonyi. Insecurity, including kidnappings on highways and in schools, remains one of the biggest issues for voters ahead of the January 2027 elections.
more: Obi says he would personally go into the bush to rescue kidnap victims.
He promised free primary education and at least 10,000MW of power.
He criticised Tinubu for not visiting Bayelsa.
